name: Goochie Pooch & Cats Too
status: operating (unverified - listings only, no recent reviews seen)
website: none (goochie-pooch.com is now a parked GoDaddy lander)
what_they_do: Independent dog and cat grooming salon on Route 18 with a long local history and a BBB profile. Standard baths, cuts and cat grooming; no services, prices or hours published anywhere the business controls.
customers: Local pet owners in East Brunswick and Old Bridge

size_signals.signal: Single-location salon with a BBB business profile; YellowPages lists Mon-Fri 9-5 hours
~92 reviews accumulated on a groomer directory, implying steady historical volume

website_review.out_of_date_signs: The old domain goochie-pooch.com now serves a GoDaddy 'this domain is parked free' page with unrelated ad links - the site has lapsed
website_review.search_basics: No site to index; brand searches land on directory stubs or the parked domain
top_issues: No working website; expired domain is now a parked ad page
Conflicting hours across directories (Mon-Fri 9-5 vs Tue-Sat 9-4)
No online booking and no published prices

agent_readiness.notes: Directories carry the address and phone but disagree on hours, and anyone typing the obvious domain gets a GoDaddy lander. No services, prices or policies in readable text; booking is phone-only.

operations_signals.signal: Two directories publish different opening hours - nobody is maintaining listings (inference)
~92 reviews but no owned channel to rebook or remarket them; all inbound is phone

top_opportunities.opportunity: Relaunch a one-page site on the lapsed domain with services, prices, hours, click-to-call and a real booking link (Booksy/Fresha) - a groomer with 92 reviews has demand but nowhere to convert it
top_opportunities.evidence: goochie-pooch.com is a parked GoDaddy page; no booking path exists anywhere

top_opportunities.opportunity: Reclaim the Google Business Profile and reconcile hours, categories and photos so the two conflicting hour sets stop confusing searchers and crawlers
top_opportunities.evidence: YellowPages says Mon-Fri 9-5; another directory says Tue-Sat 9-4

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated reminders and rebooking texts to cut phone tag and no-shows
top_opportunities.evidence: Phone-only scheduling at a salon with high review volume (inference)

scores.reasons: Dead website and phone-only booking is a large, obvious gap; a small owner-operated salon has a modest budget; a relaunch plus booking link is fast work. We could not confirm current trading beyond directory listings.
